Ticket #88412 is the one for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging. I replied in your thread in #central-random.

The source is a #central-team thread from July 2, 2025, so I couldn't confirm whether the ticket is still open. I also replied that #4912 is a separate Tansleigh issue, a phantom lock on Door 6 at their Marietta plant, which came in through deal desk in March.
